intent: Troubleshooting Bluescreen on MSI Katana GF76 with RTX 3050
detected_fault: BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) during gaming on Cyberpunk 2077
suggested_solution: Review Windows update history and remove recent updates that may have caused the issue.
Uninstall Intel graphics driver, run on basic MS graphics driver temporarily, and then reinstall Intel driver with updated version.
Run SFC /scannow and DISM checks to identify and fix any system errors.
Update Intel iGPU driver directly from Intel's website.
Run Windows update and reboot to test if the issue persists.
